description: Set the legal name of the business this account screens numbers for (PATCH /v1/me). Required before a live key can screen. Voll Studios Ltd, the company behind TPSClear, is licensed by the DMA as a TPS and CTPS list cleaner. The licence requires a monthly declaration naming each client, so a live API key must belong to an account that names the business it screens numbers for.

company_name.description: The legal name of the client business, for example "Acme Outbound Ltd".
